1. Extend the channel with the border mode to a multiple of 2^J on each side.
2. Build the steerable pyramid with J levels and K + 1 orientations.
3. For removing noise: estimate sigma, shrink every band and the high-pass residual at k sigma times the norm of its filter, and rebuild.
4. For showing one band: steer the bands of the chosen level to the angle, enlarge the result to the image, and show it around mid gray.
5. Cut the result back to the size of the channel.
